facts.fact: The Unit says MauPass, a National Authentication Framework giving citizens a digital identity for online government services, was launched in December 2020.
The Unit says MauSign is a Certification Authority licensed under the National Public Key Infrastructure, issuing digital certificates and digital signing services to citizens and organisations.
The Unit says MauPass gives access to government services online, and registered public and private entities will be authorised to read card and mobile ID data.
The Unit says a digital wallet with a mobile ID, usable for online authentication and digital signing, will be available.
